question: Why does Hebrews 12:3 tell us to consider Jesus, who endured opposition from sinners?
options: So that we will become famous
So that we will not grow weary and lose heart
So that we will fight back against sinners
So that we will stay away from people
explanation: Hebrews 12:3 says consider him who endured such opposition from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.
